id: 15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course
title: 实验室安全：管理压缩气体的危害
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/15_Laboratory Safety Managing Compressed Gas and Cryogenic Hazards Training Course/src.py

points.K1: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
points.K3: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
points.K4: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
points.K12: 危害能控制，措施要落实

shots.scene: 欣欣站在货架旁，架上排着橙、蓝、黄色气瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a shelf of orange, blue and yellow gas cylinders and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识压缩气体的危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在一排颜色不同的气瓶前发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands puzzled in front of a row of gas cylinders of different colors with blank labels.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进气瓶间，看得发懵。

shots.scene: 阿杰头顶冒出问号，小研走过来
shots.prompt_en: A question mark floats above the young male student as the female graduate student walks over.
shots.narration: 这些气，各自危险在哪儿？

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个菱形危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four diamond-shaped hazard pictograms floating in the air.
shots.narration: 压缩气体的危害，取决于气体类型。
overlay: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 四个菱形图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four diamond hazard pictograms light up one by one: skull and crossbones, flame, corrosion, flame over circle. No people.
shots.narration: 通常分为有毒、易燃、腐蚀、氧化。

shots.section_title: 危害看类型：四大类，分主次
shots.scene: 一只气瓶图标旁挂着一大一小两个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with one large hazard pictogram and one smaller hazard pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一种气，常有主要和次要两种危害。

shots.scene: 草地上的白色卧式丙烷储罐，旁边是火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A white horizontal propane storage tank on a lawn with a flame pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 比如丙烷，它是易燃气体，

shots.scene: 房间里气体扩散，氧气小球被挤出去
shots.prompt_en: A simple room diagram where gas spreads and small oxygen bubbles are pushed out of the room. No people.
shots.narration: 也是窒息性气体，能把氧气挤走，

shots.scene: 黄绿色烟雾中，倒地的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A collapsed person pictogram inside a drifting yellow-green haze. No people.
shots.narration: 让人缺氧窒息。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 老周戴着吸氧面罩坐着
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits wearing an oxygen mask.
shots.narration: 有毒气体如氯气，吸入很危险，
overlay: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 鼻子、皮肤、眼睛三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nose, a hand and an eye, each with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤、眼睛也会出大问题。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 刻度表指针停在美国限值线以下
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with a marked limit line and a small stars-and-stripes flag icon, the needle staying below the line. No people.
shots.narration: 接触不能超过美国职业安全卫生限值。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 穿全身防护服戴防毒面具的人站在烟雾中，旁边时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a full protective suit and gas mask stands in a haze, with a clock icon beside him.
shots.narration: 可能化学中毒，症状不一定马上出现。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
shots.scene: 工厂旁立式储罐的鸟瞰图
shots.prompt_en: An aerial view of tall vertical storage tanks beside a factory. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃气体包括氢气，
overlay: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
shots.scene: 储罐旁有通风箭头，烤架火焰和喷灯火焰图标被隔开
shots.prompt_en: A tank with airflow arrows around it, set far away from a grill flame icon and a blue torch flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要放在通风处，远离明火和火花，

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风、远离火源
shots.scene: 发热变红的设备图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a device glowing red hot with a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 远离可能过热或引燃的设备。

shots.scene: 燃气灶蓝色火焰特写，旁边一个静电小火花
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a blue gas stove flame beside a tiny static electricity spark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 哪怕静电这样极小的热源，

shots.scene: 气体云遇火花爆燃的图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cloud icon bursting into flame when it touches a tiny spark. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能让它着火甚至爆炸。

shots.scene: 腐蚀图标气瓶，旁边手形图标泛红
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a corrosion pictogram next to a hand icon with a red burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 氨、氯化氢等属于腐蚀性气体，

shots.scene: 穿头盔和防护服的老李，防护服图标上出现破洞
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a helmet and fire-resistant protective suit, beside an icon of the suit fabric with holes eaten into it.
shots.narration: 会严重灼伤皮肤，连阻燃服都能腐蚀。

shots.scene: 气瓶图标旁加入一滴水，冒出腐蚀图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon next to a single water drop; an arrow points to a corrosion pictogram appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 有的气本身不腐蚀，遇点水分就变了。

shots.scene: 立体元素周期表，氧元素方块突出
shots.prompt_en: A three-dimensional periodic table with the oxygen element tile lifting out and glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的氧化性气体是氧气。

shots.scene: 小火苗遇到氧气箭头变成大火
shots.prompt_en: A small flame grows into a big flame as oxygen arrows flow into it. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化性气体会加速燃烧，

shots.scene: 货架上的化学品桶和试剂瓶，氧气瓶与油桶之间标出距离
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of blue and white chemical drums and bottles; an oxygen cylinder stands apart from a flammable gas cylinder and an oil can with a distance arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 要和可燃气体、油类至少隔20英尺。

shots.scene: 医院病房，护士在病床旁调仪器，门上挂警示牌
shots.prompt_en: In a hospital ward, a nurse adjusts a monitor by a bed; an oxygen-in-use warning sign hangs on the door with a no open flame symbol.
shots.narration: 医院贴“正在用氧”警示，就是这个道理。

shots.scene: 氧气箭头流向其他气体和材料，冒出火焰
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen arrows flowing into another gas cloud and a pile of fabric, which bursts into flame. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气混入其他气体或材料，可能致命。

shots.scene: 仓库里用黄色栏杆围住的成排蓝色气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Rows of blue gas cylinders in a warehouse behind yellow safety railings. No people.
shots.narration: 除了气体，气瓶本身也危险。

shots.scene: 户外架上横放的银色气瓶；一只没固定的大气瓶倒向小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Silver cylinders stacked lying down on an outdoor rack, and an icon of a large unsecured cylinder tipping toward a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 大气瓶没固定好，会倒下砸伤人。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用扳手拧蓝色气瓶阀门
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a wrench on the valve of a blue gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 瓶内压力很高，

shots.scene: 阀门断裂，部件沿长箭头飞出击中小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a valve snapping off and the part flying along a long arrow to hit a box and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 断裂的部件会失控飞出，击中人和物。

shots.section_title: 危害能控制，措施要落实
shots.scene: 欣欣站在气瓶架旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a gas cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 好在这些危害可以预防。
overlay: 危害能控制，措施要落实

shots.section_title: 危害能控制，措施要落实
shots.scene: 盾牌图标罩住气瓶和气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon covering a gas cylinder and a gas cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 采取措施，安全使用、搬运气瓶。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating diamond hazard pictograms.
shots.narration: 有毒、易燃、腐蚀、氧化，分清主次。

shots.scene: 易燃气瓶远离火源，氧气瓶与油桶隔开
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder far from a flame, and an oxygen cylinder far from an oil can. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃远离火源，氧气远离可燃物。

shots.scene: 倾倒的气瓶和飞出的阀门图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tipping cylinder and a valve part flying off. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶会倒、部件会飞，同样危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣在气瓶架旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a gas cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 认清危害，安全用气，下次见！
